description: This file defines API endpoints for managing user notifications, including listing, counting unread, updating, marking all as read, deleting, and creating notifications. It uses FastAPI framework conventions, interacts with a database, and integrates security dependencies.

methods.description: Marks all notifications as read for the current user.

methods.name: delete_notification( notification_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
